title: SSO Login Issue for Non-Admin Users
summary: Non-platform-admin SSO users are unable to log in due to an unconditional redirect to the admin page, which requires admin privileges. This affects all SSO providers and prevents regular employees from using the platform as a platform_viewer or team-scoped team_admin.
root_cause: The SSO callback handler unconditionally redirects all authenticated users to /admin, which requires admin privileges
impact_description: Non-platform-admin SSO users are immediately bounced back to /admin/login?error=admin_required with the message 'Admin privileges required', even when they have legitimate team-scoped roles and access to non-admin parts of the platform.
